study type: post-hoc analysis of prospective observational studies and randomized controlled trials
cohort: 204 term and preterm infants delivered by cesarean section
finding: Cerebral blood volume (CBV) decreased significantly in the first 15 minutes after birth in all infants, with a smaller decrease observed in infants who received respiratory support.
mod_finding: The study found a significant decrease in cerebral blood volume in both term and preterm infants delivered via cesarean section, regardless of whether they required respiratory support.
